title: arbaee'n karne ko aayi hai behan
body:
arbaee'n karne ko aayi hai behan
peshwaayi ko mere aaye koi
housla mera badhaaye to koi
mujhko seene se lagaye to koi
<<DIVIDER>>
kya hua mere gharaane ka chalan
mera abbase dilawar hai kahan
mera armaa'n mera akbar hai kahan
jhule wala ali asghar hai kahan
<<DIVIDER>>
ye batao hai kahan ibne hassan
mai kabhi koocha o bazar me thi aur kabhi qaide sitam gaar me thi
sar barehna sare bazaar me thi
gir pada phat ke na kyu charqe kohan
<<DIVIDER>>
bazuou me mere rassi thi bandhi
pusht kodou se badan hai zaqmi
har qadam par thi ek uftaad nayi
bazuou par hai mere daaghe rasan
<<DIVIDER>>
apna mu ashkou se dhone wali
raat din apko rone wali
mar gayi seene pe sone wali
us ka zindaa'n me banake madfan
